blocks.text: Read it like a treasure map. First, A and B swap places. Follow the orange arrow through four numbered moves. Then look for the flat dashed line at the centre of the curve.

blocks.label: Three different statements
blocks.text: The displacement f<super>∘4</super> − id has zero first derivative at the cycle points; the cycle Lyapunov exponent is zero; and the defined matrix has fourth power I. Each statement follows from the multiplier calculation.

The nonlinear fourth iterate has degree 16 for r ≠ 0, so it is not the identity map. Nor does zero cycle exponent itself prove nonlinear stability at the transition. The logistic critical point x = 1/2, where f′<sub>r</sub>(x) = 0, is another distinct use of the word “vanishing”.
The assertions above concern the two specified cycle points; they do not claim those are the only zeros of the derivative of f<super>∘4</super> − id.
